summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I found before proposing anything (read-only audit, no changes made):**  I traced the full path — `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `server.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `schema.ts` — plus the auth flow (`useAuth.tsx`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`). Contrary to the ticket's working theory, I did **not** find the suspected bug:  - The client sends `credentials: "include"` on every request — cookies go out correctly. - `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` requires a valid session on *ever
